items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: with Joe Williams. I had the quartet behind him

ctx.x: Yeah. I tried. But I just didn't like the atmosphere and politics and etcetera, you know, I don't have that kind of a temperament, you know. Some people are atuned to these things and some people aren't, you see. But I was workin', but you know I could see things...and then things went bad for...you know, they were hirin' musicians to play for these rock and roll singers and groups and they were usin' all jazz musicians, then finally, what broke

that up is that groups, they had their own band, so they didn't need the guys, older experienced musicians, to back 'em up. And then all the studio stuff went to the coast, so that broke that up, see. It was just one of those things. But I could see all these things happening, you know what I mean. So there was nothing you could do about these things. I had a couple of good jobs. I had a nice...I think it was eight weeks at the Rainbow Grill, the 65th floor of the Rockefeller Plaza with Joe Williams. I had the…
